input.quote: For the acceptance period and for a period of one year from the Maintenance Commencement Date, and thereafter for as long as the Software is covered by Maintenance Services and is used by Sparkling in accordance with this Agreement, Garman warrants that the Software shall perform in conformance with the Specifications in all material respects.
input.rationale: The conformance warranty runs for at least 12 months (and continues while maintenance is in place), the Software Repair Service gives a repair remedy at no charge, and Sections 7–8 give a rejection-and-full-refund remedy during acceptance. There is no disclaimer swallowing the express warranty. This meets the preferred position; noted only that there is no separate professional/workmanlike services warranty, no compliance-with-laws and no no-malicious-code warranty.

input.quote: (j) This Agreement constitutes the entire Agreement between the parties with respect to its subject matter, and this Agreement supersedes all prior understandings, representations, negotiations and communications between the parties, oral and written.
input.rationale: The Agreement contains no insurance covenant, although Garman installs the Software, converts our data and attends our Authorized Locations. We proposed inserting our standard limits (CGL USD 1M/2M, E&O USD 2M, cyber USD 5M where our data is accessed) with certificates on request as a new Section 20(k).
